nodes.name: Threadless Headset Assembly
nodes.description: Threadless headset system (EC, ZS, or IS) that operates on preload pressure from the top cap adjusting bolt to remove bearing play.

headset_types.name: Threadless Headset Types
headset_types.note: Operate on the same principle and share adjustment procedures

evidence.quote:
Threadless headsets, including EC, ZS, and IS types, operate on the same
principle and share adjustment procedures.

nodes.name: Threadless Top Cap and Adjusting Bolt
nodes.description: Cap and adjusting bolt assembly that puts downward pressure on the stem to adjust headset bearing preload.

function.name: Preload Pressure
function.note: Puts pressure on stem to remove play

evidence.quote:
The bolt in the top cap puts pressure on the
stem. The stem presses on spacers below the stem and the spacers put
pressure on the bearing races and bearings (figure 16.16).

nodes.name: Threadless Stem Spacers
nodes.description: Spacers placed along the steering column above or below the threadless stem to adjust handlebar height and set preload clearance.

height_adjustment.name: Height Adjustment
height_adjustment.note: Adjustability limited by number of extra spacers

evidence.quote:
Threadless stem height adjustability is limited by the number of extra
spacers used along the steering column.

nodes.name: Steering Column Star Nut
nodes.description: Threaded internal anchor driven into the steering column to receive the top cap adjusting bolt.

tooling.name: Nut Setter Tool
tooling.note: Driven into column with nut setter

evidence.quote:
The TNS-4 Threadless Nut Setter uses a sleeved guiding system to drive
the star nut into the column.

nodes.name: Threadless Headset Bearing Preload Adjustment
nodes.description: Procedure of applying compression to headset bearing races via the top cap adjusting bolt to remove bearing play before tightening stem binder bolts.

bearing_preload.name: Bearing Preload Objective
bearing_preload.note: Bearing races must press against bearings

evidence.quote:
Bearing races must press against
the bearings to remove play.

nodes.name: Steerer Tube Diameter (unconfirmed)
nodes.description: Estimated 28.6 mm steerer tube diameter noted in visual repair diagram inspection.

evidence.quote: Steerer Tube Diameter: Est. 28.6 mm (1 1/8 inch).

nodes.name: Stem Clamp Bolt Torque Specification (unconfirmed)
nodes.description: Typical 5-7 Nm stem clamp bolt torque estimate from visual inspection, requiring verification with stem manufacturer specifications printed on stem body.

evidence.quote: Stem Clamp Bolts: Typically 5-7 Nm. Refer to stem manufacturer's specification printed on the stem body.
